BrochureContent.Content:
Looking for your dream detached home with spectacular unrestricted sea views across Balbriggan harbour, the Irish Sea and towards the Cooley and Mourne Mountains but yet in very close proximity to all local amenities and services, then look no further!! 

This beautiful four bedroom detached bungalow is situated on its own mature private grounds in one of Balbriggan most desirable coastal addresses. A large lawned garden surrounds the property along with trees and mature shrubbery giving a true sense of serenity and privacy. The accommodation has superb living space with large windows capturing the breathtaking sea views.

The property benefits from a PV Solar Panel system with both a domestic Hot Water Solar System and a Hot Water Booster Pump and an oil-fired condenser boiler. 

Balbriggan town centre offers a host of amenities and services along with the train station that provides daily services to and from Dublin City centre and its suburbs. 

Balbriggan is home to the Irish Institute of Music and Song and the Lark Theatre. It is also conveniently situated near the coastal town of Skerries and a short drive to the M1 motorway providing very easy access to the city centre, Port tunnel and Dublin International Airport.  
Rejuvenation works around the harbour area are almost completed, with a multi-purpose plaza to host social events and markets. The works will redefine both sides of the historic viaduct also enhancing the beach and coastline. The redevelopment will bring increased social and commercial activity to the area. 

With ample space and generous accommodation, this property offers any purchaser a great opportunity to settle into an idyllic family home by the sea.
